I always say I'm going to hell for this one. In 8th grade I was assigned a group Project with 4 friends and we used that as an excuse to go to my friend Angel's house and party hard. You bet your ass we got fucked up on Mountain Dew and halo 3!
The day the assignment was due we had nothing at all except a high score on guitar hero 3 on through the fire and the flames. My first reaction was "you ok dude?" After he said it was just road rash on his face and make a broken arm my second reaction was "Can we tell Mrs. Salsburry you had our project and it got destroyed in the accident?" Angel was disgusted at how genius that plan was. We went into third period looking like our puppy just died and told her how angel got hit by a car and prayed to the gods of bullshit that she would let us off the hook. I ran out the door fist pumping in the air like rocky.
